versions.changelog:
Initial release: Unified AI video generation across the full RunComfy model catalog.

- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video using top models: HappyHorse 1.0, Seedance, Kling, Wan, Dreamina, Hailuo, Veo, and more.
- Smart routing by user intent—automatically selects the best model for needs like in-pass audio, lip-sync, cinematic motion, speed, or duration.
- Offers detailed usage and model-picking guidance, covering features and best use cases.
- Simple CLI integration: trigger video generation via the runcomfy CLI with minimal command inputs.
- Activates on a wide range of natural language prompts related to AI video creation.
